[&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Dynamic workflows are available on all paid plans, with Anthropic API access, and on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. On Pro, turn them on from the Dynamic workflows row in <code>/config</code>.</span></div></div>
<span data-as="p">A dynamic workflow is a JavaScript script that orchestrates many <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents">subagents</a> at once. Claude writes the script for the task you describe, and a runtime executes it in the background while your session stays responsive.</span>
<span data-as="p">Reach for a workflow when a task needs more agents than one conversation can coordinate, or when you want the orchestration codified as a script you can read and rerun. Examples include a codebase-wide bug sweep, a 500-file migration, a research question that needs sources cross-checked against each other, and a hard plan worth drafting from several independent angles before you commit to one.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="when-to-use-a-workflow"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#when-to-use-a-workflow">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">When to use a workflow</span></h2>
<span data-as="p"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents">Subagents</a>, <a class="link" href="/docs/en/skills">skills</a>, <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-teams">agent teams</a>, and workflows can all run a multi-step task. The difference is who holds the plan:</span>

repeatable</td><td style="text-align:left">The worker definition</td><td style="text-align:left">The instructions</td><td style="text-align:left">The team definition</td><td style="text-align:left">Interruption</td><td style="text-align:left">Restarts the turn</td><td style="text-align:left">Restarts the turn</td><td style="text-align:left">Teammates keep running</td><td style="text-align:left">Resumable in the same session</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">A workflow moves the plan into code. With subagents, skills, and agent teams, Claude is the orchestrator: it decides turn by turn what to spawn or assign next, and every result goes into a context window. A workflow script holds the loop, the branching, and the intermediate results itself, so Claude’s context holds only the final answer.</span>
<span data-as="p">Moving the plan into code also lets a workflow apply a repeatable quality pattern, not just run more agents: it can have independent agents adversarially review each other’s findings before they’re reported, or draft a plan from several angles and weigh them against each other, so you get a more trustworthy result than a single pass.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="run-a-bundled-workflow"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#run-a-bundled-workflow">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Run a bundled workflow</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">The quickest way to see a workflow in action is to run <code>/deep-research</code>, the <a class="link" href="#bundled-workflows">built-in workflow</a> Claude Code includes for investigating a question across many sources. You’ll see agents work through a set of phases in the background while your session stays free, and get one report at the end instead of a turn-by-turn transcript.</span>

<span data-as="p">To run a workflow for your own task, <a class="link" href="#have-claude-write-a-workflow">have Claude write one</a>, and once a run does what you wanted you can <a class="link" href="#save-the-workflow-for-reuse">save it</a> as a command of your own.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="bundled-workflows"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#bundled-workflows">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Bundled workflows</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code includes <code>/deep-research</code> as a built-in workflow:</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_3kllktbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Command</th><th style="text-align:left">What it does</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>/deep-research &lt;question&gt;</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Fans out web searches on a question across several angles, fetches and cross-checks the sources it finds, votes on each claim, and returns a cited report with claims that didn’t survive cross-checking filtered out. Requires the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/tools-reference#websearch-tool-behavior">WebSearch tool</a> to be available</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p"><code>/deep-research</code> runs only when you invoke it.</span>
<span data-as="p"><a class="link" href="#save-the-workflow-for-reuse">Workflows you save</a> yourself become commands the same way and appear in <code>/</code> autocomplete alongside the bundled ones.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="watch-the-run"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#watch-the-run">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Watch the run</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Workflows run in the background, so the session stays responsive while agents work. Run <code>/workflows</code> at any time to list running and completed workflows, then select one to open its progress view.</span>
<span data-as="p">The progress view shows each phase with its agent counts, token totals, and elapsed time. The footer lists the key for each action:</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_54llktbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Key</th><th style="text-align:left">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>↑</code> / <code>↓</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Select a phase or agent</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>Enter</code> or <code>→</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Drill into the selected phase, then into an agent’s detail. In the detail, <code>Enter</code> expands or collapses it</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>Esc</code> or <code>←</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Back out one level. In v2.1.203 through v2.1.205, <code>←</code> didn’t step back out of a phase or agent; use <code>Esc</code> on those versions</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>j</code> / <code>k</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Scroll within the agent detail when it overflows</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>f</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Filter the agent list in the selected phase by status. Press again to cycle</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>p</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Pause or resume the run</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>x</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Stop the selected agent, or stop the whole workflow when focus is on the run</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>r</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Restart the selected running agent</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>s</code></td><td style="text-align:left"><a class="link" href="#save-the-workflow-for-reuse">Save</a> the run’s script as a command</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">The agent detail lists the agent’s prompt, its recent tool calls, and its result. Each call shows its state, such as still running or failed. When the agent keeps a task list of its own, the detail shows it too, with each task’s status.</span>
<span data-as="p">Press <code>Enter</code> to expand the detail. The prompt and result then show in full, and each listed call shows its input and the start of its result.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="have-claude-write-a-workflow"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#have-claude-write-a-workflow">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Have Claude write a workflow</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">You can have Claude write a workflow for your task in two ways:</span>
<ul>
<li><a class="link" href="#ask-for-a-workflow-in-your-prompt">Ask for a workflow</a> in your prompt, either in your own words or by including the keyword <code>ultracode</code>, and Claude writes one for the task.</li>
<li><a class="link" href="#let-claude-decide-with-ultracode">Let Claude decide with ultracode</a>: set <code>/effort ultracode</code> and Claude plans a workflow for every substantive task in the session.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">You can also run a workflow command that already exists: a <a class="link" href="#bundled-workflows">bundled workflow</a> like <code>/deep-research</code>, or one you’ve <a class="link" href="#save-the-workflow-for-reuse">saved</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="ask-for-a-workflow-in-your-prompt"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#ask-for-a-workflow-in-your-prompt">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Ask for a workflow in your prompt</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">To run a single task as a workflow without changing the session’s effort level, include the keyword <code>ultracode</code> in your prompt. Asking in your own words, for example “use a workflow” or “run a workflow”, also works: Claude treats a direct request as the same opt-in.</span>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code highlights the keyword in your input and Claude writes a workflow script for the task instead of working through it turn by turn. The keyword only chooses how Claude structures the work: the agents’ tool calls receive the same permission checks and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing">sandboxing</a> as any other tool call in the session.</span>
<span data-as="p">If the run does what you wanted, you can <a class="link" href="#save-the-workflow-for-reuse">save it as a command</a> afterward. If you already have an orchestrator built another way, such as a folder of subagent prompts or a skill that fans work out, you can point Claude at it and ask for a workflow that does the same thing.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="dismiss-or-turn-off-the-keyword"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#dismiss-or-turn-off-the-keyword">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Dismiss or turn off the keyword</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">If you didn’t mean to start a workflow, press <code>Option+W</code> on macOS or <code>Alt+W</code> on Windows and Linux to dismiss the highlight for this prompt, or press backspace while the cursor is right after the highlighted keyword. To stop the keyword from triggering at all, turn off Ultracode keyword trigger in <code>/config</code>.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="where-the-keyword-works"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#where-the-keyword-works">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Where the keyword works</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">The keyword is an opt-in only in a prompt you type yourself: at the interactive prompt, in an IDE extension panel, in a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control">Remote Control</a> client, or in an Agent SDK application that stamps your keyboard input’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-sdk/typescript#sdkmessageorigin"><code>origin</code></a> as <code>{ kind: "human" }</code>. It doesn’t start a workflow when it reaches the session another way:</span>
<ul>
<li>a prompt passed with <code>-p</code></li>
<li>a prompt an Agent SDK application sends without stamping it as human input</li>
<li>a scheduled task prompt</li>
<li>a webhook payload or pull request comment relayed into the conversation</li>
</ul>
<div aria-label="Note" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-600/20" data-callout-type="note" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-4 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M 9 1.6714 C 13.0371 1.6714 16.3286 4.9629 16.3286 9 C 16.3286 13.0371 13.0371 16.3286 9 16.3286 C 7.0574 16.3252 5.1953 15.552 3.8217 14.1783 C 2.448 12.8047 1.6748 10.9426 1.6714 9 C 1.6714 4.9629 4.9629 1.6714 9 1.6714 Z M 9 0 C 4.0371 0 0 4.0371 0 9 C 0 13.9629 4.0371 18 9 18 C 13.9629 18 18 13.9629 18 9 C 18 4.0371 13.9629 0 9 0 Z M 10.2857 3.8571 H 7.7143 V 10.2857 H 10.2857 V 3.8571 Z M 10.2857 11.5714 H 7.7143 V 14.1429 H 10.2857 V 11.5714 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="none"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Before v2.1.210, the keyword started a workflow from any of these routes too, including a webhook payload or pull request comment relayed into the conversation.</span></div></div>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="let-claude-decide-with-ultracode"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#let-claude-decide-with-ultracode">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Let Claude decide with ultracode</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Ultracode is a Claude Code setting that combines <code>xhigh</code> <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level">reasoning effort</a> with automatic workflow orchestration. With it on, Claude plans a workflow for each substantive task instead of waiting for you to ask.</span>

class="line"><span>/effort ultracode</span></span>
<span class="line"><span></span></span></code></pre></div></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="code-block-fade-overlay print:hidden" data-fade-overlay="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<span data-as="p">To start a session with ultracode already on, launch with <code>claude --effort ultracode</code>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.203 or later.</span>
<span data-as="p">To turn it on while you choose a model, move the <code>/model</code> picker’s effort slider to <code>ultracode</code> with the arrow keys. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level">Adjust effort level</a> lists the routes that turn ultracode on.</span>
<span data-as="p">With ultracode on, Claude decides when a task warrants a workflow. A single request can turn into several workflows in a row: one to understand the code, one to make the change, and one to verify it. This applies to every task in the session, so each request uses more tokens and takes longer than at lower effort levels.</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>/effort ultracode</code> lasts for the current session; to have every session start with it, set the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#ultracode"><code>ultracode</code></a> setting. Drop back with <code>/effort high</code> when you return to routine work. The <code>/effort</code> menu offers it only <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#when-ultracode-is-available">when ultracode is available</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="approve-the-plan-before-it-runs"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#approve-the-plan-before-it-runs">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Approve the plan before it runs</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">In the CLI, the per-run prompt shows the planned phases and these options:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Yes, run it</strong>: start the run</li>
<li><strong>Yes, and don’t ask again for <code>&lt;name&gt;</code> in <code>&lt;path&gt;</code></strong>: start, and skip this prompt for this workflow in this project from now on. Claude Code offers this option when you run a bundled, saved, or plugin workflow by name, not for a script Claude wrote for the current task.</li>
<li><strong>View raw script</strong>: read the script before deciding</li>
<li><strong>No</strong>: cancel</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><code>Ctrl+G</code> opens the script in your editor. <code>Tab</code> lets you adjust the prompt before the run starts.</span>
<span data-as="p">Whether you see this prompt depends on your <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permission-modes">permission mode</a>:</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_ckllktbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Permission mode</th><th style="text-align:left">When you’re prompted</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left">Auto</td><td style="text-align:left">First launch only. Any <strong>Yes</strong> records consent in your user settings, and later launches start without prompting. Skipped entirely when ultracode is on</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">Manual, accept edits</td><td style="text-align:left">Every run, unless you’ve selected <strong>Yes, and don’t ask again</strong> for that workflow in this project</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">Bypass permissions</td><td style="text-align:left">Claude Code doesn’t prompt you. The run starts immediately</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>claude -p</code>, Agent SDK</td><td style="text-align:left">Claude Code doesn’t prompt you</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">In <code>claude -p</code> and the Agent SDK, Claude Code never shows this prompt. It runs the Workflow tool call through the same <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-sdk/permissions#how-permissions-are-evaluated">permission evaluation</a> as the rest of the session, so deny rules, ask rules, and <code>dontAsk</code> mode apply to the launch as they apply to every tool call. To let the workflow start in these runs, use one of these:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Permission rule</strong>: <code>Workflow</code> in your allow rules approves every workflow, and <code>Workflow(&lt;name&gt;)</code> approves one saved workflow by name.</li>
<li><strong>Auto permission mode</strong>: the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permission-modes#eliminate-prompts-with-auto-mode">classifier</a> reviews the call and can approve it.</li>
<li><strong>Bypass permissions mode</strong>: Claude Code approves the call.</li>
<li><strong>A <code>PreToolUse</code> hook</strong>: a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#pretooluse">hook</a> that returns <code>allow</code> for the call approves it.</li>
<li><strong>Your host</strong>: a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cli-reference#cli-flags"><code>--permission-prompt-tool</code></a> approves it, or, with the Agent SDK, a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-sdk/permissions"><code>canUseTool</code></a> callback or a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#permissionrequest"><code>PermissionRequest</code> hook</a> approves it.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">In the Desktop app, an approval card shows the workflow name, the phase list, and a token-usage caution, with <strong>Once</strong>, <strong>Always</strong>, and <strong>Deny</strong> actions. The progress view appears in the Background tasks side pane.</span>
<span data-as="p">The subagents the workflow spawns use your <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings-reference#permission-settings">permission rules</a>, and Claude Code picks their permission mode by the rules under <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#permission-modes">which permission mode a subagent runs in</a>. To avoid prompts on a long run, add the tools the agents need to your allow rules before starting.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="save-the-workflow-for-reuse"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#save-the-workflow-for-reuse">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Save the workflow for reuse</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">When Claude writes a workflow for a task you’ll repeat, you can save that run’s script as a command. A process like a review you run on every branch then runs the same orchestration each time.</span>
<span data-as="p">Run <code>/workflows</code>, select the run you want to keep, and press <code>s</code>. In the save dialog, Tab toggles between the two save locations:</span>
<ul>
<li><code>.claude/workflows/</code> in your project: shared with everyone who clones the repo</li>
<li><code>~/.claude/workflows/</code> in your home directory: available in every project, visible only to you. If you set <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR</code></a>, this location is the <code>workflows/</code> directory under that path.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">The save dialog shows the resolved path for the personal location.</span>
<span data-as="p">Press Enter to save. The workflow runs as <code>/&lt;name&gt;</code> in future sessions from either location.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code checks the save location for symlinks before writing, and shows an error instead of writing through one. What it checks depends on where you save:</span>
<ul>
<li>Project location: Claude Code refuses if <code>.claude</code>, <code>.claude/workflows</code>, or the target file is a symlink.</li>
<li>Personal location: Claude Code refuses only if the target file itself is a symlink, so a <code>~/.claude</code> directory managed by a dotfiles tool still works.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Before v2.1.216, Claude Code followed the link, which could place the file outside the location you chose.</span>
<span data-as="p">In a monorepo with several <code>.claude/</code> directories, you can keep workflows alongside the package they apply to. As of v2.1.178, saving to the project location writes to the closest <code>.claude/workflows/</code> directory that already exists between your working directory and the repository root, or to the repository root if none exists yet. Project workflows also load from every <code>.claude/workflows/</code> along that path, and when more than one defines the same name Claude Code runs the one closest to the working directory.</span>
<span data-as="p">If a project workflow and a personal workflow share a name, the project one runs.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="distribute-a-workflow-in-a-plugin"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#distribute-a-workflow-in-a-plugin">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Distribute a workflow in a plugin</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">To share a workflow across teams or repositories, include it in a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins">plugin</a>. Place the script in a <code>workflows/</code> directory at the plugin root, or point to a different location with the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugins-reference#component-path-fields"><code>workflows</code> manifest field</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Plugin workflows are namespaced by the plugin name. A plugin called <code>acme-tools</code> containing a script whose <code>meta.name</code> is <code>release-audit</code> runs as <code>/acme-tools:release-audit</code>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="pass-input-to-a-saved-workflow"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#pass-input-to-a-saved-workflow">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Pass input to a saved workflow</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">A saved workflow can accept input through the <code>args</code> parameter. The script reads it as a global named <code>args</code>. Use this to supply a research question, a list of target paths, or a configuration object at invocation time instead of editing the script for each run.</span>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="example-workflow-prompts"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#example-workflow-prompts">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Example workflow prompts</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">A workflow fits best when the task is larger than one agent can hold in context, or when the same step needs to run across many items. The prompts below show common shapes. Each one asks Claude to write and run a workflow for that task; you don’t write the script yourself.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="audit-many-files-for-the-same-issue"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#audit-many-files-for-the-same-issue">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Audit many files for the same issue</span></h3>

You usually don’t need to edit it, but here is the shape of a small one so you can recognize what Claude generated:</span>
